DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P1701 col 144, P1702 col 145, identical to ES3032 line 13 and to the questionnaire's column codes (144)(145)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 8 sets item = the variable name (p1701, p1702; lower-casing is Stata naming, a mechanical case change of the CIS code) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P1701 'Lo importante es que las personas que lo desean puedan adoptar un/a niño/a en cualquier caso' and P1702 'Lo importante es dar a los/as niños/as una familia cuando carecen de ella' match the two rows of the Pregunta 17 grid in cues3032.pdf character for character, 2/2 (the questionnaire's line-break hyphenations 'per-/sonas' and 'cual-/quier' rejoined; read from a 300-dpi render of the scanned page, not OCR). VALUE LABELS identical on both: 1 'Muy de acuerdo' 2 'Bastante de acuerdo' 3 '(NO LEER) Ni de acuerdo ni en desacuerdo' 4 'Poco de acuerdo' 5 'Nada de acuerdo' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.', matching the questionnaire's numbered list. RESP GAP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 3 (the volunteered, not-read midpoint), 8 and 9 to missing without renumbering, so live resp is {1,2,4,5} and option rows ship for those four codes only; no row for 3 is shipped because no live response carries it. Dropped by the .do (p1701/p1702): code 3 324/131, code 8 91/47, code 9 7/7. CHECKED ANYWAY, decisive: reading DA3032 (2464 records, all 385 bytes; id = row number) at cols 144-145, dropping 3/8/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 254 and cov_age cols 255-256 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 4321 rows both, 2350 live ids, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex stored as the Stata value label (1 -> 'Hombre' 2113 rows, 2 -> 'Mujer' 2208, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1/2/4/5): p1701 749/790/354/149, p1702 1270/942/52/15 -- both items use all four levels. Live values read from the local irw cache copy table_context.R had just written; validate_items.R --table-sets passed (2 items, resp {1,2,4,5}). No filter precedes P.17 in the questionnaire (asked of all respondents). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the Pregunta 17 stem verbatim from cues3032.pdf, shared by both rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section. The stem carries no interviewer direction (no MOSTRAR TARJETA), so nothing was dropped from it; the '(NO LEER)' option is not shipped because its code is absent from the live data. translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3032 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by this project (anchor English matches the wording used for the same CIS anchors in other spain_* rounds) -- issues-page line owed at upload. Not an instrument-name mismatch: the dictionary description (adults who wish to can adopt, versus giving children a family) matches the two P.17 statements in order.
